rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something relating to or belonging to an orchestra.

example.english: We invited an orchestral conductor for an interview.
example.traditional: 我哋請咗管弦樂團嘅指揮嚟做訪問。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 gun2 jin4 ngok6 tyun4 ge3 zi2 fai1 lai4 zou6 fong2 man6

rows.note: Use this specifically when describing music, a piece, or a sound played by an orchestra.

example.english: This orchestral music sounds very powerful.
example.traditional: 呢段管弦樂聽落好有氣勢。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 gun2 jin4 ngok6 teng1 lok6 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3
